commands.name: ascii

options.name: --console
options.description: Write the output to the console (stdout) instead of a  file. The output path argument becomes optional.

options.name: --max-width
options.description: Maximum characters per output line before cells wrap  to a new row. Default 160. Must be in [[40, 400]].

options.name: --port
options.description: PostgreSQL port number. Only packets from/to this port will be processed. If omitted, auto-detected from the TCP SYN handshake.

commands.name: fields

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.description: Output file path. Leave empty to generate a file  at the same location as input file. Ignored with --console.

commands.description: Render each message as labelled, content-sized field  boxes. Pass --console / --max-width before the mode.

commands.name: sequenceDiagram

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.description: Output file path. Leave empty to generate a file  at the same location as input file. Ignored with --console.

commands.description: Render a two-lifeline (Client/Server) sequence  diagram. Pass --console / --max-width before the mode.
ASCII diagrams — field boxes or a sequence diagram;  supports --console.

commands.name: batchexport

options.name: --port
options.description: PostgreSQL port number. Only packets from/to this port will be processed. If omitted, auto-detected per file from the TCP SYN  handshake.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recurse into subdirectories of  <input_dir>.

arguments.name: output_dir
arguments.description: Output directory. One subfolder per input pcapng will  be created here. Defaults to docs/examples/exports.

commands.description: Run every exporter and every variant over every .pcapng /  .pcap in a directory.

commands.name: capture

options.name: --device
options.description: Capture device override (Name or Description).  Auto-picked from --host if omitted.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Capture duration (e.g. 30s, 5m). If omitted, capture  runs until Ctrl+C.

options.name: --host
options.description: PostgreSQL host (used to auto-pick the capture  device). Defaults to localhost

options.name: --list-devices
options.description: List available capture devices and exit.

options.name: --port
options.description: PostgreSQL port. Defaults to 5432

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Do not echo per-packet lines to the console while  capturing.

commands.description: Record a .pcapng from a live NIC in-process (SharpPcap; no external tcpdump). Use --list-devices to enumerate adapters.

commands.name: demo

options.name: --no-run
options.description: Walk through the tour without prompting or executing  anything (also what you get when output is piped / non-interactive).

commands.description: Interactive guided tour: walks through every command  (starting with ascii) and can run each against a bundled sample capture.

commands.name: html

options.name: --port
options.description: PostgreSQL port number. Only packets from/to this port will be processed. If omitted, auto-detected from the TCP SYN handshake.

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.description: Output file path. Leave empty to generate a file at  the same location as input file

commands.description: Generate a self-contained, guided-reading HTML report.

commands.name: latex

options.name: --exact
options.description: Render each bitbox with width equal to the on-the-wire byte count of the field. Long content wraps to the next bytefield row and string content is emitted as LaTeX-escaped literal UTF-8 (no truncation).

options.name: --multiple
options.description: When set, one file is generated per message in  standalone mode

options.name: --port
options.description: PostgreSQL port number. Only packets from/to this port will be processed. If omitted, auto-detected from the TCP SYN handshake.

options.name: --row-bytes
options.description: Bytefield row width in bytes (used for wrapping in  --exact mode). Default 32. Typical values: 16, 32, 64. Must be in [[8, 256]].

options.name: --standalone
options.description: When set will generate standlone LaTeX documents,  ideal for short messages. Leave unset to generate LaTeX articles with page  breaks when possible

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.description: Output file path. Leave empty to generate a file at  the same location as input file

commands.description: Generate LaTeX bytefield diagrams (standalone documents or a paged article).
